privacy.title: How we handle your data
privacy.lead: Short and plain. We collect what the gang needs to decide, nothing more.

stored.title: What we store
stored.guest: Guest session: when you create or join a plan you get an anonymous account on this device, with a random id.
stored.name: Name: the name you type when you join. It is shown to the others in the plan.
stored.plans: Plans, votes and comments you make, and which events have been added to a plan.
stored.account: Email and password if you create an account. The password is stored encrypted (hashed) by our sign-in service, never in plain text.
stored.browser: In your browser: the name you last used, your chosen theme (dark or light) and your chosen language. The language is kept in a single functional cookie (NEXT_LOCALE). Nothing else, no advertising or tracking cookies. During password recovery, this tab temporarily remembers the account id so reloading keeps the reset form open; it is cleared on completion, cancellation or sign-out.

who.title: Who sees what
who.plan: A plan, its votes and its comments are only seen by the people in the plan. Whoever has the link can see the plan's name, date, who is in and the options before they join.
who.comments: Comments on events are public to signed-in visitors and require an account.
who.sell: We don't sell data and we show no advertising.

events.title: Events and tickets
events.body: Events are fetched from the sellers' open listings, today Ticketmaster. We don't sell tickets: you are sent to the seller, and the purchase follows their terms and privacy policy. When an event is added to a plan we store a small copy of its details (name, place, time, image link, price and ticket link) so the plan keeps working even if the seller changes or removes the listing. We remove the seller's details if the seller or the organiser asks us to.

where.title: Where the data lives
where.body: The database and sign-in run on Supabase in Stockholm (EU). The site runs on Vercel. Both are our subprocessors and handle data only on our behalf.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, and you can stop using the service at any time. If we delete your account, your votes and comments disappear too. Contact details will be published when the service launches.

privacy.footnote: Gänget is an independent concept under development. This text describes how it works today and is updated when that changes.
